title: Anchoring VAE Fine-Tuning to Its Latent Diffusion Prior
abstract: arXiv:2611.31651v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pretrained latent diffusion models are effective priors for transfer learning, from geometry estimation to physics simulation. Existing approaches fine-tune the diffusion backbone but freeze the encoder of the VAE to preserve the latent distribution. However, a frozen encoder may miss salient details in non-RGB inputs and is limited to three channels. We introduce Diffusion Prior Anchoring (DPA), a regularizer applied during VAE fine-tuning that uses a score-distillation update to steer latents toward the high-density manifold on which the pretrained diffusion model denoises accurately. We validate DPA across three image and video models (FLUX 3, LTX-Video, Wan2.2) and four tasks: monocular depth estimation, MRI reconstruction, wind-flow simulation, and surface normal estimation, where DPA lowers the prediction error by 7.5% relative to the frozen VAE, 4.9% to decoder-only fine-tuning, and 4.0% to unanchored VAE fine-tuning. translated_title: 将VAE微调锚定于其潜空间扩散先验
translated_abstract: 预训练的潜空间扩散模型是迁移学习的有效先验，应用范围涵盖从几何估计到物理模拟等多个领域。现有方法通常微调扩散主干网络，但冻结变分自编码器（VAE）的编码器以保持潜变量分布。然而，冻结的编码器可能遗漏非RGB输入中的重要细节，且仅限于三个通道。我们提出了扩散先验锚定，这是一种在VAE微调过程中应用的正则化方法，通过分数蒸馏更新将潜变量引导至预训练扩散模型能够准确去噪的高密度流形上。我们在三个图像和视频模型（FLUX 3、LTX-Video、Wan2.2）以及四项任务（单目深度估计、MRI重建、风流模拟和表面法线估计）上验证了DPA的有效性。实验表明，DPA相对于冻结VAE将预测误差降低了7.5%，相对于仅解码器微调降低了4.9%，相对于未锚定的VAE微调降低了4.0%。
tldr: 提出扩散先验锚定（DPA）正则化方法，在VAE微调时通过分数蒸馏将潜变量引导至预训练扩散模型能准确去噪的高密度流形，在多个模型和任务上将预测误差降低4.0%至7.5%。
en_tdlr: Proposes Diffusion Prior Anchoring (DPA), a regularizer that uses score-distillation to steer latents toward the high-density manifold of the pretrained diffusion prior during VAE fine-tuning, reducing prediction error by 4.0-7.5% across multiple models and tasks.
